about: Chromatography and electrophoresis: method (class keys: flow, inj, column-temp, oven, inlet, det, split, inlet-mode, run, wl, gradient, pmax, rate, speed, eluent, voltage, current, constant, lamp, plus native names), load, run (job), stop, chromatogram (trace + peak table), quantify, flow on|off, set-temp --zone, status. power / open / close come from the shared layer.

not_in_this_class.agilent_hs8697, markes_unityxr, frontier: GC front ends (headspace, thermal desorption, pyrolysis, purge and trap): primary in sample_intro; they inject into a GC but run no separation themselves

verbs_changed_from_the_first_draft.quantify: kept for concentration from external standards (SFC, IC, GC-IMS); TLC (track amounts), GPC and AF4 (molar mass) answer not-supported with their own capability as the alternative
verbs_changed_from_the_first_draft.load: IC (valve load position), Selekt (run.setup dialog) and the 7890B (syringe) are not sample loading on these twins: the sample comes from the lab, or `run` draws and injects it (7890B)
verbs_changed_from_the_first_draft.flow: CPC rotor.start/stop is the rotor in local control, not the mobile phase: not supported; 8890 column carrier on/off (method.configure column on) and HPLC mobile-phase availability were added
verbs_changed_from_the_first_draft.chromatogram: 7890B (live FID current only) is not supported; 8890 reads the last run of the run path (gc.last_run) instead of the instant chromatography.measure fixture (one native path per verb); Selekt and CPC read the run history (a trace) instead of the live snapshot query

shared_verbs_redefined.method: one canonical dictionary over 1-6 native calls per member (oven programs, settings objects, per-zone temperatures, required arguments kept from the current method); the shared method maps one capability only
shared_verbs_redefined.stop: must use the same native path as run and chromatogram (one path per verb group, §5.2) and refuses NOT_RUNNING before sending

run.label: sample loaded

run: run sends Prep Run first when the GC is not READY yet (no Not-Ready reasons left), then Start; the run follows the oven program
load: the 8890 twin loads a virtual vial with the oven lid open (>= 60 deg) - the class opens and closes the lid
method: oven=... sets the oven start temperature (thermal.set_temperature) and the ramp table (method.configure oven); the ramp after the last one gets rate 0 so the program ends there

before.step: draw the sample into the syringe

after.step: insert the needle into the inlet

run.label: oven program set
run.message: the oven program of {inst} has no length (initial time 0 and no ramp), so the run would never end.
run.fix: set an oven program: `chemlab run {inst} method oven=50C:1min..250C@20C/min:2min`.

run.label: syringe at the vial
run.message: the syringe needle of {inst} is still in the inlet.
run.fix: withdraw it: `chemlab call {inst} syringe.retract`.

unsupported.load: manual syringe injection: `run` draws the sample from the vial into the syringe and injects it after Start
unsupported.chromatogram: the 7890B keeps no trace (the FID signal goes to a data system); read the live signal with `chemlab read agilent_7890b_ssl_fid detector.output_a run.state run.time_s`
unsupported.quantify: it has no calibration / quantification capability

alternatives.chromatogram: `chemlab read agilent_7890b_ssl_fid detector.output_a run.state run.time_s` (live FID current), `chemlab call agilent_7890b_ssl_fid logs.read --log run` (run log)

run: manual injection as on the instrument: draw the sample, press Start, insert the needle, inject, withdraw; the run ends at the end of the oven program
method: oven=... sets the oven start temperature, the initial time and one oven.set_ramp per ramp; the ramp after the last one gets rate 0 so the program ends there

method.fix: switch it off first (`chemlab run {inst} flow off`), set the method, then `flow on` again.

acquisition.start:NOT_READY.message: {inst} is not ready to start: a temperature is not at the method yet, the cover is open, or the column still holds the last injection.
acquisition.start:NOT_READY.fix: wait (`chemlab run {inst} run --wait-ready 10min`); after a stopped run let the gas flush the column for a few minutes (`chemlab wait 5min`).
